00046 SpawnBaseUGenInternal::SpawnBaseUGenInternal(const int numInputs, const int _numChannels, const int maxRepeats) throw()
00047 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(numInputs, _numChannels-1),
00048  numChannels(_numChannels),
00049  currentEventIndex(0),
00050  maxRepeats_(maxRepeats),
00051  bufferData(new float*[numChannels]),
00052  stopEvents(false)
00053 {
00054  ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00055  ugen_assert(maxRepeats >= 0);
00056  initEvents();
00057 }

00059 SpawnBaseUGenInternal::~SpawnBaseUGenInternal()// throw()
00060 {
00061  delete [] bufferData;
00062 }
00063 
00064 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00065 {  
00066  if(reachedMaxRepeats() == true && events.sizeNotNull() == 0) shouldDelete = true;
00067  
00068  if(shouldStopAllEvents() == true) initEvents();
00069  
00070  const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00071  const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00072  for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00073  {
00074   bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00075  }
00076  
00077  mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID);
00078  mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamplesToProcess, numChannels);
00079  mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00080 }

00082 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::releaseInternal() throw()

00106 SpawnUGenInternal::SpawnUGenInternal(const int numChannels, const double nextTime_, const int maxRepeats) throw()
00107 : SpawnBaseUGenInternal(0, numChannels, maxRepeats),
00108  nextTime(nextTime_),
00109  nextTimeSamples(0)
00110 {
00111  ugen_assert(nextTime >= 0.0)
00112 }
00113 
00114 void SpawnUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00115 {
00116  // render the current voices
00117  SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00118  
00119  const unsigned int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00120  const unsigned int nextBlockID = blockID + blockSize;
00121  
00122  if(nextTimeSamples < nextBlockID && reachedMaxRepeats() == false)
00123  {
00124   // now overdub new voices this block
00125    
00126   if(nextTimeSamples < blockID)
00127    nextTimeSamples = blockID;
00128   
00129   const int blockOffset = nextTimeSamples - blockID;
00130   int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize - blockOffset;  
00131   const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00132   
00133   if(blockOffset > 0)
00134   {
00135    for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00136    {
00137     bufferData[channel] += blockOffset;
00138    }
00139   }
00140   
00141   do
00142   {
00143    UGen newVoice = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++);
00144    newVoice.prepareForBlock(blockSize, blockID); // prepare for full size (allocates the output buffers)
00145    
00146    UGen::setBlockSize(numSamplesToProcess);
00147    newVoice.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, nextTimeSamples); // prepare for sub block
00148    
00149    unsigned int nextTimeSamplesDelta = (unsigned int)(nextTime * UGen::getSampleRate());
00150    
00151    for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00152    {
00153     bool shouleDeleteLocal = false;
00154     float *voiceSamples = newVoice.processBlock(shouleDeleteLocal, nextTimeSamples, channel);
00155     accumulateSamples(bufferData[channel], voiceSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00156     bufferData[channel] += nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00157    }
00158    
00159    events <<= newVoice;
00160    
00161    numSamplesToProcess -= nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00162    nextTimeSamples += nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00163   } 
00164   while(nextTimeSamples < nextBlockID && reachedMaxRepeats() == false);
00165   
00166   UGen::setBlockSize(blockSize); // reset
00167   
00168   mixer = Mix(&events, false);  
00169  }
00170 }
